sentences.en: Surge capacity was lacking in most countries during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，大多数国家缺乏应对能力。

sentences.en: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
sentences.zh: 近年来，对职业治疗的需求急剧增加。

sentences.en: The Great Depression triggered a great surge in crime.
sentences.zh: 大萧条引发了犯罪率的巨大增长。
